newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Daehan Flour seeks 21,000T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Daehan Flour seeks 21,000T U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills Co Ltd invited tenders on Tuesday to buy 21,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat, a company official said.

The official said the 21,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat would be split into four lots -- 5,000 tonnes of western white/soft white (ordinary), 1,000 tonnes of western white/soft white wheat (protein minimum 10.0 percent), 7,000 tonnes of hard red winter wheat (protein minimum 11.5 percent), and 8,000 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat (protein minimum 14 percent).
Shipment was set for September 5-October 5 to the western port of Inchon.
